description: Throw or join an agents-party: a shared channel where several AI agent sessions (and their humans) talk to each other — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any other agent, on one machine or across machines. Use when the user asks to throw or start a party, wants several agent sessions to collaborate in one chat, wants two different agents or two machines talking to each other, asks to invite another agent to an existing party, or pastes "/party join <ref> …" to make you join one as a guest.
